say:1:1322032001:1.text: You've returned. Did you discover anything?
say:1:1322032001:1.source_cn: 你们回来了，有什么发现吗？

choice_prompt:2:1322032001.text: You've returned. Did you discover anything?
choice_prompt:2:1322032001.source_cn: 你们回来了，有什么发现吗？

say:3:1322032002:1.text: New Graveborn?! And they're responsible for what happened in Cedartown...
say:3:1322032002:1.source_cn: ……新来的亡灵？！又有新的亡灵出现，还影响到了雪松镇的...

say:4:1322032003:1.text: But based on what you said, they're not criminals.
say:4:1322032003:1.source_cn: 但听你的描述，他们应该不是什么为非作歹之徒。

choice_prompt:5:1322032003.text: But based on what you said, they're not criminals.
choice_prompt:5:1322032003.source_cn: 但听你的描述，他们应该不是什么为非作歹之徒。

say:6:1322032004:1.text: Indeed, no serious crimes were committed.
say:6:1322032004:1.source_cn: 的确，他们还算遵纪守法。

say:7:1322032006:1.text: Since Lady Shemira has promised not to disturb the people here again, I believe we can take some time to assess our situation and plan our next steps carefully.
say:7:1322032006:1.source_cn: 既然那位叫雪米拉的亡灵女士保证不会再来打扰这里的人们，...

say:8:1322032007:1.text: If they truly keep their word, I won't expel them from Whiteridge.
say:8:1322032007:1.source_cn: 如果他们确实做到了自己所承诺的，我也就不必将他们驱逐出...

say:9:1322032008:1.text: Lately, the people of Whiteridge have been in a state of panic, and we're already stretched thin on manpower. If we can avoid it, I'd rather not provoke another conflict with the Graveborn.
say:9:1322032008:1.source_cn: 这阵子白山人心惶惶，我们也很缺人手……如果并非必要，我...

say:12:1322032009:0.text: Yes, we also think this is our best option.
say:12:1322032009:0.source_cn: 嗯，我们也觉得这样是最好的方法。

say:13:1322032010:1.text: I owe you my heartfelt thanks for all you've done. Though I can't make promises on behalf of the duchy, know that I will personally stand by you if you ever need aid in the future.
say:13:1322032010:1.source_cn: 请允许我向你们表达感谢，你们实在帮了我们太多……我无法...

say:14:1322032011:1.text: I have some official duties to attend to, so I'll take my leave.
say:14:1322032011:1.source_cn: 我还要去处理一些公务，先告辞了。

narration:15:1322032012:0.text: Over the next few days, Cedartown returns to its usual tranquility, and the townsfolk slowly let go of their fears. Captain Rodrigo, who had been so consumed by worry, finally feels at ease.
narration:15:1322032012:0.source_cn: 之后的一段时间里，雪松镇果然又回归了以往的平静，人们渐...

narration:16:1322032013:0.text: A few days later, you run into the patrol captain again at the entrance of Cedartown.
narration:16:1322032013:0.source_cn: 几天之后，你在雪松镇门口又一次碰到了巡逻队长。

say:18:1322032005:1.text: I understand the feelings of a parent. Mine are always worried about me as well.
say:18:1322032005:1.source_cn: ……我能理解作为父母的心情，父母也总是很担心我。

choice:5:1:2.text: The mother was strict but reasonable.
choice:5:1:2.source_cn: 那个母亲严厉有加，但很讲理
choice:5:1:2.male: The mother was strict but reasonable.
choice:5:1:2.female: The mother was strict but reasonable.
